profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at EXL
profile.summary: Software engineer who loves to take on new challenges, learn, and teach others. I have experience building full stack applications using NodeJS, ExpressJS, ReactJS, HTML, CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build and own the implementation of several features
- Integrate CI/CD azure pipeline to automatically run Cypress tests to ensure code quality
- Help bring in and onboard junior developers into project and codebase
- Write code reviews to keep high code quality
- Integrate NextJS application with multiple backend services and API's including REST and GraphQL servers
- Build reusable components using React
- Ensure that code was stable by writing unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library
- Refactor and update components to avoid and reduce number of bugs
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Industry and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Own, strategize, and lead the implementation of multiple features end to end for GCU Halo Learning - 
   Management System utilizing NextJS, Typescript and GraphQL
- Optimize UI load time and decrease GraphQL requests  by more than %50 by incorporating NextJS 
   persistent layout across app
- Ensure accessibility for users with disabilities through the implementation of semantic HTML and 
   following the latest accessibility standards

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Refactor and decouple ReactJS components utilizing React Hooks, Redux, and Context to avoid and - 
   reduce bugs and increase code testability and quality
- Implement CI/CD pipeline to run automated end to end Cypress tests and app deployment to AWS 
   with Azure Pipelines
- Maintain code quality  by writing unit tests for components and utility functions utilizing JEST and 
   React Testing Library
positions.insights: Front-End Design, Software Design and +5 skills

positions.title: Section Lead
positions.description:
• Managed and led 8 teaching assistants and over 70 students across 3 different time zones
• Developed strategies to instruct students learning web development
• Took initiative with students  and built guided projects using React, ExpressJS, NodeJS, JWT’s, Auth0 among other technologies
• Facilitated communication between students, teaching assistants, and instructor
• Maintained student resources which they used to learn Git, Redux, SQL, JavaScript among other technologies

positions.title: Lambda X Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
•  Planned and executed project strategy to build and deploy application
• Worked closely with project stake to implement application features
• Successfully built image uploading feature for ReactJS web application while integrating Google Cloud Services
• Implemented OAuth authentication using Firebase

positions.title: WebPT10 Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Administered daily code reviews to students learning web development
• Engaged and successfully fixed numerous bugs for web application projects in ReactJS, ExpressJS, Postgres, Redux, Git, CSS, HTML, NodeJS, SQL
• Implemented authentication workflows using stateless JWTs, cookie-based systems, and third- party OAuth providers like Firebase and Auth0
• Aided in the deployment of many projects to the cloud using Heroku, Netlify, Firebase among others

honors.title: Most Learned MLH Local Hack Day Award
honors.description: Participated in Local Hack Day hackathon and accomplished building a web game with 4 other teammates. The award was given due to the fact that most of the team had little to no experience. At the end we accomplished getting our game functional and were able to gain great learnings.
honors.issuer: Issued by Major League Hacking · Dec 2018
